title: Two-period crossover trial (AB/BA)
summary: The period-adjusted treatment effect from within-patient period differences compared between sequences.

sizing._note: A crossover's within-patient comparison is sized like a paired design, using the SD of the within-patient differences.

pinned_defaults: Both: the period-1 minus period-2 differences are compared BY SEQUENCE and halved, which cancels the period effect.
Both: BA first, so the effect is B minus A.
_carryover: The analysis assumes no carryover: the washout must make that plausible. A test for carryover compares sequence totals and has little power; it should not decide the analysis.
